teaching_language: Depends on the Japanese host institution (the language of instruction or supervision there); the application itself is written in English or French

milestones.label: Application deadline, 2026 cycle (extended)
milestones.source_text: UNESCO's programme page (official) says the deadline was extended to 15 October 2026; scholarship sites report the earlier date as 30 September 2026. Applications go through National Commissions for UNESCO, which need them earlier. Research stays start from February 2027. No results date is published.
